findings.label: Form validation UX softening
findings.detail: React port adds noValidate to the enquiry form, so native tooltips no longer appear on empty name or non-10-digit mobile — the JS handler only focuses the invalid field. The gate behaviour (invalid data does not open WhatsApp) matches the original, so this is a UX regression on invalid submits, not a validation hole. Fix later: drop noValidate from the form; required and pattern="[0-9]{10}" are still on the inputs.

findings.label: fetchpriority casing warning
findings.detail: Hero.jsx uses the lower-case `fetchpriority` HTML attribute. React 18 prefers the camelCase `fetchPriority` prop and will emit a dev-console warning, but the built dist/index.html carries the correct `fetchpriority="high"` attribute so runtime behaviour is unaffected. Non-blocking cosmetic; rename to fetchPriority in Hero.jsx.
